trust_decision.summary: PreviousMap decides whether a path taken from an untrusted /*# sourceMappingURL= */ comment in the input CSS may be read from disk as a previous source map; at the pinned commit any existing path is read with no extension or content check (lib/previous-map.js loadMap -> loadFile).

landing_point.why: The summary names sourceMappingURL in CSS comments; the annotation branch of loadMap joins that comment's value to dirname(from) and calls loadFile.

fix_sites.entry_point: postcss().process(css, {from, map}) / postcss.parse(css, opts) -> new Input -> new PreviousMap (lib/input.js:71)
fix_sites.module_kind: core library, source map loader (loadFile: .map extension gate, trusted flag)

fix_sites.module_kind: core library, source map loader (JSON.parse validation of the loaded content, return undefined on failure)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Weak case only: a solver could argue that the opts.map.prev function path (lib/previous-map.js:100-103) is caller-controlled and exempt, and the published fix agrees by passing trusted=true, so nothing is really left open to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Real sibling .map files must still load from a relative annotation, including maps with the )]}' XSSI prefix; opts.map.prev functions may return any path; inline data: maps must keep working. A fix that rejects every annotation or every relative path would break these.

annotation path to a .map file with non-JSON content (rejected by JSON.parse)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted decodeInline variant that accepts a file: URL or a plain path in the data branch and reads it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Inline and external maps are handled side by side, so a maintainer adding file: URL support could plausibly route it through a reader with no gate. This is a WHERE-type sibling, so it counts only as an extra.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an extension check done on the raw annotation before join/normalisation (e.g. a ?query or #hash suffix stripped later)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Source map URLs often carry query strings, and stripping them after the check would be a realistic parser differential (HOW-type). It is not present at the pinned commit.

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file read with information disclosure via untrusted file reference (CWE-22, CWE-200)

O10_build.project_tests: test/previous-map.test.ts (uvu); the fix diff adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject '..' or absolute paths in the annotation, or confine reads to dirname(from); that still allows non-map files next to the CSS and may break legitimate ../maps/x.map layouts.

out_of_scope_notes: The published fix still lets an annotation traverse to any *.map file outside the CSS directory (only the extension and JSON shape are checked); this is a residual design choice, not a route the fix missed.
Input.toJSON copies PreviousMap fields, including text/mapFile/json, into serialized output (lib/input.js:258-263); this is a by-design disclosure surface and was not pursued.
